title: Console
description: Run the platform: workspaces, server health, limits and defaults.

probe.failedBody: The settings check did not answer. Nothing was changed.

toast.failed: That did not work. Try again.

errors.slug_pattern: Use 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit.
errors.slug_taken: That slug is already used by another workspace.
errors.slug_mismatch: Type the slug exactly to confirm.
errors.password_short: Use at least 8 characters, or leave it empty to generate one.
errors.range_1_365: Enter a whole number from 1 to 365.
errors.range_5_300: Enter a whole number from 5 to 300.
errors.range_0_10000: Enter a whole number from 0 to 10,000.
errors.range_1_500: Enter a whole number from 1 to 500.
errors.range_0_3650: Enter a whole number from 0 to 3,650.
errors.last_owner: A workspace needs at least one active owner.

tenants.title: Workspaces
tenants.description: Each workspace is one customer team with its own users, knowledge base, rubric and API key.
tenants.emptyBody: Create the first workspace to give a team its own space.

form.createBody: An API key is generated for the workspace and shown once.
form.name: Name
form.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It cannot be changed later.

toast.deactivated: {{name}} is paused. Its users cannot sign in.

secret.label: API key
secret.note: Copy it now. Afterwards only the masked hint is kept. The previous key stops working at once.

rotate.title: Rotate the API key for {{name}}?
rotate.body: A new key is generated and the current key stops working immediately. Anything still using it will fail until it is updated.

deactivate.title: Pause {{name}}?
deactivate.body: Its users will not be able to sign in and its API key is refused. Nothing is deleted, and you can activate it again.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: This removes the workspace with its users, calls, knowledge base, rubric and usage history. It cannot be undone.

tenantUsers.title: Users in {{name}}
tenantUsers.description: People who can sign in to this workspace.
tenantUsers.emptyBody: Add the first person for this workspace.
tenantUsers.roleHint: Owners edit settings, the rubric and the knowledge base. Members review calls.

form.passwordHint: Leave empty to generate one. It is shown once.

secret.label: Password
secret.note: Share it with the user now. It is not stored and cannot be shown again.

reset.title: Reset the password for {{name}}?
reset.body: A new password is generated and the old one stops working.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: This user will no longer be able to sign in.

health.title: Server health
health.description: Live resource use of the platform and the load each workspace puts on it.
health.livePaused: Updates pause while this tab is hidden

load.title: Load by workspace
load.description: Requests, AI calls and audio work in the selected range. Share is each workspace's part of the total load.

settings.title: Health settings
settings.description: How long samples are kept and how often a new one is taken.

health.loadFailed: Health data could not be loaded.

users.title: Registered users
users.description: People with a personal account on the public tools, and the limits their tier gets.

defaults.title: Registered tier defaults
defaults.description: Every registered user gets these limits unless you set a personal override.

limitsDialog.title: Limits for {{name}}
limitsDialog.description: Leave a field empty to follow the tier default.

reset.title: Reset the password for {{name}}?
reset.body: A new password is generated and the old one stops working.

secret.title: New password for {{name}}
secret.label: Password
secret.note: Share it with the user now. It is not stored and cannot be shown again.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: The account and its usage counters are removed. This cannot be undone.

limits.enabledHint: When off, every request from this tier is refused.

anonymous.enabledHint: When off, visitors who are not signed in see the sign-in prompt instead of the tools.
anonymous.title: Anonymous limits
anonymous.description: What a visitor who is not signed in may do on the public tools.
anonymous.limitsDescription: Allowances reset every day for each visitor.
anonymous.sentimentDescription: A short tone read on public clips, shown to signed-in visitors.
anonymous.guidanceHint: Added to the instructions the reader follows. Up to 1,000 characters.

storage.title: Retention
storage.description: How long recordings are kept before they are removed.
storage.summary: Recordings older than {{days}} days are removed, together with their audio and transcripts.

voices.title: Voices
voices.description: Choose which text-to-speech voices the public tools offer.
voices.allBody: Every voice in the catalogue is offered. Switch to a selection to restrict the list.
voices.previewFailed: The preview could not be played.
voices.loadFailed: The voice catalogue could not be loaded.
